test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) NQ-LP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea910c1477cdd3b08fff7f17b23526153d5f12e1ee09478cabda148b5c7bda06.png] 

Option 2) FI-DG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0368c48ac6bfd879642213da944143639db9543f95d14ea317a0fbcdbffb46c2.png] 

Option 3) IL-GJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c69f1a3b0dd4de572e5dd49bf2fa510d09360857fd49499eb33ae7b057121fe3.png] 

Option 4) DG-BE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f2fd61c727c88ebd6cfa64cbe53cc5ebc4f2a5d3fa7ffd5d3dd51dd17ecc788.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'NQ-LP' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
